services.title: Roof Inspection
services.short: A full sweep of the roof, the attic and every penetration.
services.text: A thorough roof inspection that gives you a complete picture of your system's condition, then a clear plan for what it needs.
services.imageAlt: A roofer checking shingles and flashing during a roof inspection
body: A strong report starts with a full sweep of your roof system. We check decking for soft spots, test ventilation, and study flashing around chimneys and vents. Then we walk penetrations, valleys, and the attic to spot hidden moisture.

After hail or high winds, we offer a free roof inspection to spot storm damage quickly. This complimentary visual check costs you nothing, helping us flag lifted shingles or dented flashing before leaks start.

Buying or selling? Our paid inspections dig deeper for real-estate deals. A careful inspection measures remaining life and lists every needed fix, so both sides know the true condition before closing.
points: Decking checked for soft spots
Ventilation tested
Flashing around chimneys and vents
Penetrations, valleys and the attic walked
Free storm assessment after hail or high wind

faqs.a: A storm assessment after hail or high winds is a free visual check. Detailed inspections for a real-estate sale are paid, because they measure remaining roof life and list every needed fix.

faqs.q: How often should a roof be inspected?
faqs.a: Regular visits let us catch decay, rot and moss early, which saves time and money. We schedule routine maintenance checks for owners who want the roof looked at on a set cycle.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.short: A new roofing system installed start to finish.
services.text: A flawless installation sets the foundation for a highly durable roof, and we manage the whole process so the result stands the test of time.
body: If you are seeking a fresh start, our roof installation service brings you top-quality materials and professional workmanship. We install new roofing systems efficiently and with close attention to detail, so they hold up for decades.

We install high-performance systems designed to boost curb appeal and stand up to the elements. Our specialized teams cover the whole job, from the first inspection, damage report and estimate through product selection, financing and install.

You get a written proposal before anything starts. We explain the roofing materials and the warranty choices, keep you posted during the project, and finish with a quality check on the completed work.
points: The whole process managed from inspection to final check
Product selection and financing handled with you
A written proposal before work starts
Materials and warranty options explained
A final quality check on the finished roof

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, lifted shingles and failed flashing, traced and fixed.
services.text: Dependable roof repair that protects your home or business, with high-quality materials so the job is done right the first time.
services.imageAlt: Hail-damaged asphalt shingles on a residential roof
body: A damaged roof requires immediate attention from professionals who understand local conditions. We offer prompt, reliable roof leak repair to prevent water damage from spreading and causing more serious issues.

As your roofing repair contractor we believe in transparency. Our process begins with a detailed inspection to identify all areas of concern, from obvious damage to hidden weak spots. We give you a clear explanation of our findings and a straightforward repair plan, so you know exactly what to expect.

We focus on cost-effective repair solutions without compromising on quality. The goal is to fix the immediate problem while strengthening your roof against future issues, so the repair is built to last.
points: Roof leak repair
Comprehensive damage assessment
Residential roof repair
Hidden weak spots identified, not just visible damage
A written repair plan before work starts

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A full tear-off to the deck, fresh underlayment and new roof.
services.text: A full replacement rebuilds the whole protective system above your head, from decking to underlayment to the top layer.
services.imageAlt: New asphalt shingles installed on a steep residential roof
body: A worn-out roof in a Gulf Coast climate is a real problem, and it rarely fixes itself. Between spring hail, summer heat that blisters shingles, and hurricane season stress, older roofs give out fast around here.

Our replacement starts with a complete tear-off down to the deck. We inspect every board for rot, moisture or weak spots and replace damaged decking before anything new goes on. We lay fresh underlayment and seal valleys, vents and chimneys with ice-and-water shields to block heavy, wind-driven Gulf rain.

We install quality materials for both residential and commercial jobs, including asphalt shingles, metal and tile. We also pull the required county permits and help with any HOA approvals. Most jobs take one to three days, scheduled in advance.
points: Complete tear-off down to the deck
Damaged decking replaced before anything new goes on
Fresh underlayment, with ice-and-water shields at valleys, vents and chimneys
Asphalt shingles, metal and tile
Permits pulled and HOA approvals handled

faqs.q: When is replacement the better call than repair?
faqs.a: When the roof is near the end of its life, you spot heavy granule loss in the gutters, decking has soft or rotted spots, or leaks keep coming back after every storm.

faqs.q: How long does a replacement take?
faqs.a: Most jobs take one to three days, fully scheduled in advance.

services.title: Roof Maintenance
services.short: Scheduled care that catches small problems before they grow.
services.text: Proactive maintenance that extends the life of your roof and helps you avoid unexpected costly repairs down the road.
services.imageAlt: A pitched asphalt shingle roof seen from the ridge
body: A well-maintained roof is your first line of defense against the elements, and our proactive approach keeps it performing at its best. We identify and address minor issues before they escalate into major headaches, such as leaks and water damage.

Our process starts with scheduling a convenient time for our team to visit your property and perform a thorough evaluation. We then provide a clear, detailed report and recommend the best course of action.

Through regular inspections our team can spot loose shingles, clogged gutters or damaged flashing. Addressing those early helps you avoid expensive repairs and prevents structural damage. We handle everything from debris removal to sealing minor cracks.
points: Thorough property evaluation and a detailed written report
Loose shingles, clogged gutters and damaged flashing caught early
Debris removal
Minor cracks sealed
Customized maintenance plans for Texas homeowners

services.title: Storm And Hail Damage
services.short: Hail, wind and driven rain, assessed and documented fast.
services.text: When a named storm rolls off the Gulf, your roof takes the first hit, and the damage often hides until the next downpour finds it.
services.imageAlt: Storm-damaged roof shingles lifted and torn by high wind
body: We built our storm response around Gulf Coast reality. From March hail to late-season hurricanes, we know how weather events batter local roofs and how quickly small breaches turn into interior leaks. Our team acts fast to stop water, secure your home, and set up lasting repairs.

Wind, hail and driven rain each leave different marks. On shingles, look for bruising and lost granules from hail. Tile cracks or slips under wind. Metal dents and seams loosen. The fix has to match the material, not just patch the most visible spot.

Move fast once the winds die down. We tarp exposed sections, document every hit with photos, and control water intrusion before it soaks decking or drywall. Quick action limits interior loss and strengthens your claim, and we dispatch a crew the same day when possible.
points: Same-day crew when possible
Exposed sections tarped
Every hit documented with photos
Roof, flashing and penetrations inspected
Repairs matched to the roof material

services.title: Emergency Roof Repair
services.short: 24/7 response: tarp the breach, then plan the lasting fix.
services.text: When a storm rips through the Gulf Coast, water starts finding its way inside within minutes. We stabilize your home first, then plan the lasting fix.
body: Our emergency work runs in two clear stages. First we tarp the breach, seal exposed areas, and stop water from spreading into your walls, insulation and belongings. Once conditions clear, we return for permanent repairs, replacing damaged shingles, flashing and decking so the roof withstands the next storm.

Not every leak needs a midnight visit, but some do. Call us when you see active dripping, sagging decking or exposed rafters. Fallen limbs, missing shingles and sudden water intrusion all signal an emergency.

Water rarely enters where it drips. We trace stains and moisture back to the real source, whether that is a lifted flashing or a punctured shingle, so the repair lands on the actual opening rather than a guess.
points: Emergency line answered 24/7 on (832) 280-1690
Heavy-duty tarping anchored to sound decking
Water traced back to the true entry point
Damaged shingles, flashing and decking replaced
Every step photographed and logged for your insurance claim

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Single-ply, modified bitumen, metal and silicone restoration.
services.text: Install, repair and replacement across a full range of commercial roofing materials, with full insurance, bonding and warranty options behind the work.
body: WABO Roofing Systems aims to be the Greater Houston area's first choice for commercial roofing services, and has evolved into one of the most versatile roofing contractors in the region. Our experience and the relationships we have formed with our clients are the most important factors in our success.

We know how important it is to keep a commercial roof in good condition, and how costly it can be to make unnecessary repairs or deal with premature replacement. Our contractors help you make an educated decision about your commercial roof project.

In any economy, roof restoration makes sense. A silicone roof coating extends the service life of your existing roof and avoids the cost and inconvenience of replacement. These highly reflective coatings have been used to restore millions of square feet of commercial and industrial roofing.
points: Single-ply membrane systems (TPO, EPDM)
Torch-down and modified bitumen
Asphalt shingles
Metal roofing (standing seam, R-panel)
Silicone coatings and roof restoration
Full insurance, secure bonding and warranty options

about.title: Know More About Your Most Trusted TX Home Improvement Contractor

WABO Roofing opened its doors in 2016, and since then have committed to being one of Texas' most reputable contractors that offers roofing, windows, gutters, siding and patio installation in Houston and the surrounding areas.

Here at WABO Roofing, integrity is one of our core values, and it serves as a competitive advantage. Our reputation for ethical business practices is one of the main reasons our clients and suppliers value their relationship with us.

A company founded on integrity and customer excellence, WABO Roofing is an A+ rated accredited company with the Better Business Bureau and a Master Shingle Applicator through CertainTeed, and a GAF Master Elite Contractor. We are fully licensed, insured and bonded, adding multiple layers of protection to you and your investment.

facts.heading: Referral program
facts.text: Send us a referral and you earn $50 once our representative meets them and gives them a free proposal, with no strings attached. If they hire us, you earn a bonus on top once the project is complete and paid in full: $25 under $1,000, $50 from $1,000 to $4,999, $100 from $5,000 to $9,999, $150 from $10,000 to $14,999, $200 from $15,000 to $19,999, $250 from $20,000 to $24,999, and 1% of the selling price over $25,000. Email wilsonb@waboroofing.com with their name, address, email, cell number and the service they need, along with your own contact details and address so we can send the check.

facts.heading: Quotes and proposals
facts.text: Call us or fill out the form and we will set up a time to meet you at your home or business for a free, no-obligation quote. You can also request an instant estimate for a new roof. Every proposal is written, and it details the work, the materials, the timeline and the cost.

items: GAF LayerLock shingles for WindProven coverage
Work completed to applicable Texas coastal windstorm requirements

facts.heading: GAF warranty options
facts.text: GAF offers Shingle & Accessory, Roofing System, System Plus, Silver Pledge and Golden Pledge limited warranties, and coverage depends on the products, the property type and the warranty selected. Silver Pledge and Golden Pledge include specified misapplication coverage, which standard product warranties do not. Qualifying LayerLock-labeled shingles can carry a 15-year WindProven limited wind warranty with no maximum wind-speed limit, when the specified GAF accessories and installation are used. We will name the exact warranty in your proposal and handle the registration.

facts.heading: CertainTeed warranty options
facts.text: CertainTeed covers manufacturing defects, with SureStart as the initial non-prorated period. Its current chart lists Landmark with 110 mph standard wind coverage and a conditional 160 mph upgrade, and 25-year algae coverage with qualifying algae-resistant hip and ridge accessories, otherwise ten years. SureStart PLUS adds extended protection on eligible systems installed by credentialed contractors, and the materials, labor, tear-off, disposal and workmanship covered differ by plan.
